title: Student vanishes on mountain excursion in Minas Gerais
place_text: Mountainous region of Minas Gerais, Brazil

tellings.quote: This very well-known event involving a group of students who were on an excursion in the mountainous region of Mina. and one of the girls moved away from the group for a while and just vanished.

plain: Aldo Rebelo, a former Brazilian defense minister, tells of a well-known event in the mountains of Minas Gerais, a state in Brazil, that was reported in the local press. He says a group of students was on a trip there when one girl walked away from the group for a while and simply vanished. He tells it as one of the strange, unexplained cases from his country.
